description: This file defines the ImportNode class within the Twig templating engine. It represents an import node in the template syntax tree, handling the compilation of import expressions and related attributes.

classes.name: ImportNode
classes.description: Represents an import node in a Twig template, responsible for compiling import statements and managing their associated expressions and variables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an ImportNode with an expression and a variable, issuing deprecation warnings if parameters are deprecated.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to perform the import operation during Twig template rendering, handling special cases such as self-imports.
